svg.title: YOLO-Seg 的相鄰方法比較圖
svg.desc: 三種相關方法並排，比較它們的它如何表示輸入與會交出什麼候選；底部標示共同的人工 review 邊界。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 比輸入表示與候選輸出

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 分類、分割與姿態方法可能讀同一張影像，卻把它轉成不同層級的 class、mask 或座標候選。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

g.data-semantic-relation: check a mask at seams and boundaries
g.data-must-show: YOLO-Seg：依據：known instance class/box/mask/overlap labels，加上 dense candidates、prototypes 和 instance coefficients | candidate output: 可用輸出：decode/NMS/compose 後的 per-instance box/class/mask；需驗 tiny/overlap/boundary | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: YOLO-Seg output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: YOLO-Seg：依據：known instance class/box/mask/overlap labels，加上 dense candidates、prototypes 和 instance coefficients
